verdicts.title: Multiplicative Complexity of Vector Valued Boolean Functions
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We consider the multiplicative complexity of Boolean functions with multiple bits of output, studying how large a multiplicative complexity is necessary and sufficient to provide a desired nonlinearity.
